title: Split Channels And Exposed Springs Skate Guard Pair
description: One independently authored complete pair of fixed split-channel ice-skate-blade-guard-inspired props, counted together as one model and zero scenes. Each complete guard has two separate long thick channel halves with a real empty longitudinal top slot, full floor, closed outer end and six integral broad underside transverse ribs. Two whole exposed helical spring appearances with continuous full end tangs bridge the central separation from outside the channel walls; four complete round fixing heads root them into both halves. Both full guards rest on their finite rib soles, separated side by side as the natural matched pair. Sixteen newly authored closed meshes and three opaque constant PBR roles; metre-style native Z up and centred whole-pair ground datum. No old ice-skate boot or runner is imported, no mouthguard wall is straightened or copied, and no old spring or footwear component is extracted. Entire channel cells, rib spacing, spring paths and connections are new.
